nodes.label: GLUE Home: Tauri 2 tray app
nodes.rationale: Runs on Windows/macOS as the library's engine and writer. Website on its computer is its screen. Handles disk access, analysis, streaming, syncing, job scheduling. Service page does work off main thread.

nodes.label: GLUE Website: Svelte 5 + TypeScript
nodes.rationale: Web app on GitHub Pages. Works alone offline without account. Screen for GLUE Home on its computer, or reads collections from GLUE Cloud on other devices.

nodes.label: GLUE folder: JSON files store
nodes.rationale: User's data directory with JSON files (mco.json, profiles, collections, tracks, lists, sources, backups). No database. Chosen on first run or kept in browser OPFS.

nodes.label: GLUE Cloud: Cloudflare backend
nodes.rationale: Optional account service on Cloudflare (Worker + D1 + Durable Object). Holds account collections (never music), profiles, devices. Collections can be synced and shared across devices.

nodes.label: Background loads from GLUE Home
nodes.rationale: In Home mode, page loads spectrograms, waveforms, and analysis details for rows on screen. Newest requests first. Rows that scroll away drop requests. ADR 0138 gated to 3 at a time; ADR 0139 moves to WebSocket.

nodes.label: TrackTable: library row display
nodes.rationale: UI component showing songs in library. Fixed 30px rows. Remembers scroll position per view. Shows one row per song (best copy of duplicates), omits failed analyses.

nodes.label: Collections: music folder groupings
nodes.rationale: Contains: music folders, DJ libraries, songs, playlists, analyses, events. Library's own views show one row per song (its best copy). Can be local or synced to account.

nodes.label: Account's shared collections
nodes.rationale: When cloud sync on, every collection is the account's. Stored in GLUE Cloud with snapshot and log. Same file on two computers = one song with copies on each. One sync only.

nodes.label: Profiles: artist aliases
nodes.rationale: User's artist aliases: id, name, colour, BPM range. Signed in, account keeps list (union of every device's profiles). One GLUE folder = one library opened by every alias.

nodes.label: Analysis: quality verdicts and metadata
nodes.rationale: Runs in worker pool, GLUE Home, or tab. Makes summary (verdict, tier, bandwidth, bit depth, BPM, key), full details, fingerprint, mini spectrogram, waveform. ANALYSIS_VERSION 3, VERDICT_VERSION 5.

nodes.label: Quality verdicts: lossless, upsampled, hi-res
nodes.rationale: Hi-res: content past 24kHz (ADR 0116). Lossless: steep top end with content above following music, <12% drop-outs (ADR 0119). Rule changes bump VERDICT_VERSION, stored verdicts re-checked on open.

nodes.label: Music folders (roots): song sources
nodes.rationale: Handles live in IndexedDB or GLUE Home finds them. Away (network not connected) ≠ gone. Songs don't change while away. Removing folder removes its songs.

nodes.label: Duplicates: fingerprints and deduplication
nodes.rationale: Found by fingerprints (same recording) and artist+title within 3s (probable). Only copies of same version count. User says keep/not duplicate per copy. Best: genuine, lossless, main folder, then resolution.

nodes.label: DJ library imports: Rekordbox, Engine, Traktor
nodes.rationale: Parses DJ library formats. Imports bring metadata first; music folders linked afterwards. Live sync through GLUE Home. Playlists come on demand, stay linked.

nodes.label: Cache system: spectrograms, waveforms, covers
nodes.rationale: Browser cache (OPFS cache/): full analysis details, mini spectrograms, waveforms, fingerprints, covers per collection. GLUE Home cache: t/, w/, d/, p/, s/ keyed by profile/collection/song.

nodes.label: Local link to GLUE Home: 127.0.0.1:47400-47409
nodes.rationale: HTTP routes: /hello, /connect, /fs/*, /cache, /rpc, /lease, /attach, /incoming, /dock, /folders. Every route but /hello and /connect needs token. Stopped = answers only GLUE Home windows.

nodes.label: Songs streaming by byte range
nodes.rationale: Local link in Home mode: /fs/file with byte ranges. Other computers: service worker. Between computers over WebRTC with TURN relay.

nodes.label: ADR 0138: What the user asks for goes first
ADR 0051: GLUE Home is local engine
ADR 0101: Cloud sync is the account's collections
ADR 0120: One copy shown and used
ADR 0009: JSON files store, no database
ADR 0130: Same file on two computers is one song

hyperedges.label: Home mode: local GLUE Home engine and screen
